items.title: How Salesforce efficiently right-sizes Kubernetes workloads at scale on Amazon EKS
items.summary: Salesforce operates one of the largest multi-tenant Kubernetes platforms on Amazon EKS, spanning 1,400+ clusters. See how its team combined the Vertical Pod Autoscaler and Horizontal Pod Autoscaler into a multi-dimensional autoscaling strategy that right-sizes workloads at scale and drove more than $5 million in infrastructure savings.
items.creator: Lei Liu
